cards.prompt: Swapping an SSD? Tap what's **unplugged first**.
cards.explanation: The **battery connector** comes out first, so no part has power while the SSD is swapped. Only then is it safe to touch the SSD, the RAM or anything else.

cards.prompt: This laptop lags with lots of apps open. Tap the part that's **full**.
cards.explanation: Open apps live in **RAM**, the stick with a row of chips. When too many are open, RAM fills up and the laptop lags. Storage (the long, narrow card) only fills up with saved files.

cards.prompt: Match each part to its job.
cards.explanation: The **CPU** does the work, **RAM** is the desk for what's open, **storage** keeps things for later, and the **fan** keeps the CPU cool.
Things in use right now are in **RAM**. Saved and installed things stay in **storage**, even when the device is off.

cards.prompt: Closing your open apps makes room for a big download.
cards.explanation: **False.** Closing apps frees **RAM**. A download is saved in **storage**, so making room means deleting files you don't need (or have backed up).

cards.prompt: Restarting a phone wipes its ___, but your saved photos stay.
cards.explanation: Switching off wipes **RAM**, the desk for what's open. Saved photos live in **storage**, which keeps everything with the power off.

cards.prompt: Which job gets **faster** with more CPU cores?

options.text: A puzzle where each step needs the last one
Opening one big file that can't be split

cards.explanation: Separate photos can be shared between cores. A chain of steps has to go in order, and a job that can't be split runs on one core, however many there are.

cards.prompt: Mid-game, a laptop gets very hot, then suddenly runs slower. Why?

options.text: The hot CPU is slowing itself down to stay safe
The game has filled up all of the storage
The fan has stopped working for good

cards.explanation: Too much heat makes the CPU **throttle**: it slows itself down to protect itself. Clear vents and a clean fan help it stay at full speed.
